prompts.respawn: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 12-frame respawn animation sprite sheet for Grim Run. Create 12 isolated successive frames arranged exactly four columns by three rows, equal cells, chronological left to right. Reaper must retain ivory skull and bright cyan eyes under deep navy/charcoal hood, magenta cloak lining, antique bronze armor and boots, scythe with ivory blade and bronze shaft. Sequence: frames1–3 loose dark blue-gray smoke wisps gathering above a fixed foot point, faint cyan inner glow; frames4–6 smoke becoming hooded humanoid silhouette and scythe, rising upward; frames7–9 skull/hood/hands/boots gradually solidify with smoky cloak edges; frames10–12 fully recognizable calm Reaper standing facing right, last smoke curling off hem, ending same relaxed standing pose. Many genuine small in-between changes, smooth progression, no action attack, no treasure, no bow. Scythe and hood keep consistent proportions as they form. Smoke is restrained semitransparent navy/cool gray, cyan and magenta visible only where fitting character, no white blast or large bright halo. True transparent background, generous space between cells, no grid, labels or text. 4:3 sheet.
